headline: Approved bids, waivers of competition, and contract change orders totaling multiple purchases including police equipment and lead abatement projects.
summary: The Finance Committee approved bids and waivers of competition for road salt, streetlight switchgear, lead abatement projects, park geotechnical services, guardrails and fences, police vehicles, radios, cameras, lettering, rifles, and EV charger upgrades. Most votes passed 5-0, though two items on lead abatement rebidding and police unit lettering passed 4-1.
decisions: Awarded bid MEDOT-01 for 2026-2027 winter road salt to Eastern Salt Company at $84.90/ton, approved 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition to accept Eaton Corporation's $325,236 proposal to replace streetlight switchgear, approved 5-0.
Ratified the committee's action to reject and rebid 2026-021 for Lead Abatement at 128 Oxford Street, approved 4-1, with Councilor Nagine recorded as opposed.
Awarded bid 2026-005 for lead abatement of 30 Howard St. to Region 1 Construction, Auburn, ME, at $145,190, approved 5-0.
Approved bid 2026-004 for Lead Abatement of 32 and 32.5 Bartlett Street with change orders totaling $28,995, revised contract amount $87,295, approved 5-0.
Authorized the RW Gillespie Task Order for Simard Payne Park geotechnical evaluation services, not to exceed $41,300, approved 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-027 for replacement of guardrails and fences to Premier Fence, Middleborough, MA, for an estimated $97,413, approved 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for purchase of sixty-four police units from MHQ/McGovern Auto at $4,270,889.60 net of trade-in, approved 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for sixty-three in-car VM7000 Kenwood radios from Dirigo Wireless, Inc. at $489,089.16, approved 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for forty in-car Fleet 3 Advanced car camera systems from Axon Enterprise, Inc. at $565,440.00, approved 5-0.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for lettering of forty-three Police units with Mad Monkey at $45,150, approved 4-1, with Mr. Bouh opposed.
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for seventy-one Police rifles from First Due Firearms at $200,000 net of traded-in rifles, approved 5-0.
Approved bid 2026-008 EV Chargers change order #1 for $23,600 to swap chargers for compliance, revised bid amount $68,600, approved 5-0.

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
July 13, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Mr. Bouh, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: N/A 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , City Engineer, 
Jeff Beaule, Highway Operations Manager, Reggie Poussard, Lead Program Manager, Mansour 
El-Alwi, Sargent, Joey Brown and Lieutenant, James Theiss 
 
The meeting was called to order at 5:34 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(091-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated June 15, 2026, and to accept 
and place them on file by the Clerk. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(092-2026) To award bid MEDOT -01 for  the 2026 -2027 winter road salt bid to Eastern Salt 
Company at their bid price of $84.90/ton for Lewiston. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(093-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition to accept Eaton Corporation’s $325,236 
proposal to replace the streetlight switchgear. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(094-2026) To ratify the committee’s approved action to formally reject and rebid 2026 -021 for 
the Lead Abatement 128 Oxford Street. 
 
VOTE: 4-1 
Councilor Nagine 
 
Councilor Nagine requested this vote be recorded as such for the record to memorialize his not 
being in favor of rejecting and rebidding the project.
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                                       July 13, 2026 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(095-2026) To award bid 2026 -005 for the lead abatement of 30 Howard St. to Region 1 
Construction, Auburn, ME, at their bid price of $145,190, including the $9,000 owner match. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(096-2026) To approve bid 2026-004 for the Lead Abatement of 32 and 32.5 Bartlett Street, change 
orders #1 and #2 for the additional $28,995 in materials and labor costs being added to the project 
($4,735 CO1 and $24,260 CO2) scope of the contract with RC Group, for a revised contract 
amount of $87,295. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(097-2026) To authorize the RW Gillespie Task Order for Simard Payne Park geotechnical 
evaluation services for an amount not to exceed $41,300. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(098-2026) To award bid 2026-027 for the replacement of various guardrails and fences to Premier 
Fence, Middleborough, MA, for an estimated bid amount of $97,413, based on the itemized bid 
costs using estimated quantities prepared by the Paving Manager. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(099-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition for the purchase of sixty -four (64) units as 
detailed above from MHQ/McGovern Auto for the Police Department at a cost of $4,270,889.60 
net of the $53,250 trade offer. 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(100-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition for the purchase of sixty -three (63) in -car 
VM7000 Kenwood radios from Dirigo Wireless, Inc. for the Police Department at a cost of 
$489,089.16.
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                                       July 13, 2026 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(101-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition for the purchase of forty (40) in -car Fleet 3 
Advanced car camera systems from Axon Enterprise, Inc. for the Police Department at their quoted 
price of $565,440.00. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(102-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition for the lettering of forty-three (43) Police units 
with Mad Monkey at their quoted price of $1,050 per unit or $45,150. 
 
VOTE: 4-1 
Mr. Bouh opposed 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(103-2026) To authorize a Waiver of Competition for the purchase of seventy -one (71) Police 
rifles from First Due Firearms at their quoted price of $200,000, net of fifteen traded-in rifles. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was, 
 
VOTED:  
(104-2026) To approve bid 2026-008 EV Chargers change order #1 for $23,600 to swap the four 
(4) ChargePoint chargers to model CP6621B -80A-L5.5 to meet BABA/FHWAY compliant and 
CFI requirements in the scope of the project with Maine Solar Solutions, for a revised bid amount 
of $68,600, Lewiston’s portion being $13,720. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 7:25 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
